name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
summary: A micro-credit scheme that provides collateral-free working capital loans to urban street vendors to help them resume their livelihoods, with interest subsidy and digital cashback on repayments.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant must be 18 years of age or older.
The applicant must be an urban street vendor.

entitlement_rules.text: An eligible street vendor receives a first working capital loan of Rs. 10000.

required_documents.name: Letter of Recommendation from Urban Local Body

appeal_hierarchy.description: First grievance at the urban local body.

appeal_hierarchy.authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
